BackstoryDef.title: SGC special-forces operator
BackstoryDef.description: Assigned to the Stargate program after an exacting military career, this operator learned to improvise under fire and protect a team far from Earth.

BackstoryDef.title: SGC field medic
BackstoryDef.description: This medic joined off-world teams to keep explorers alive when evacuation through the Stargate could not be taken for granted.

BackstoryDef.title: SGC researcher
BackstoryDef.description: Recruited for work on alien technology and unfamiliar biology, this researcher became accustomed to making careful decisions with incomplete information.

BackstoryDef.title: SGC linguist
BackstoryDef.description: This specialist studied languages, myths and ancient inscriptions before joining missions where a mistranslated warning could endanger an entire team.

BackstoryDef.title: SGC field engineer
BackstoryDef.description: Trained to keep equipment running under difficult conditions, this engineer accompanied SG teams whenever a remote mission needed practical solutions.

BackstoryDef.title: SGC liaison officer
BackstoryDef.description: This officer learned to negotiate between military priorities, scientific caution and the needs of communities encountered beyond the Stargate.

BackstoryDef.title: Jaffa village child
BackstoryDef.description: Raised in a Jaffa village under distant stars, this child learned communal duties, old stories and household discipline.

BackstoryDef.title: temple attendant
BackstoryDef.description: This child served around a Goa'uld temple, carrying messages and observing ceremonies long before understanding the powers behind them.

BackstoryDef.title: warrior-household child
BackstoryDef.description: Born into a household of Jaffa fighters, this child grew up around drills, armor maintenance and the expectation of service.

BackstoryDef.title: tribute-world shepherd
BackstoryDef.description: This child watched herds on a tributary world and learned to survive far from fortified settlements.

BackstoryDef.title: Jaffa artisan apprentice
BackstoryDef.description: Apprenticed to local craftspeople, this child learned the patient routines that kept a Jaffa community equipped and fed.

BackstoryDef.title: fortress child
BackstoryDef.description: This child grew up inside a fortified Jaffa garrison, where alarms, patrols and passing war bands were ordinary parts of life.

BackstoryDef.title: sanctuary ward
BackstoryDef.description: Taken in by a sanctuary community, this child learned caution, mutual aid and the value of listening before speaking.

BackstoryDef.title: training-camp youth
BackstoryDef.description: This child spent formative years around a Jaffa training camp, helping with simple duties while veterans prepared the next generation.

BackstoryDef.title: domain Jaffa warrior
BackstoryDef.description: This Jaffa fought for a Goa'uld domain, enforcing its borders and obeying commands delivered in the name of a distant master.

BackstoryDef.title: Goa'uld temple guard
BackstoryDef.description: Stationed at a Goa'uld temple, this Jaffa guarded sacred spaces and learned the rituals of rigid hierarchy.

BackstoryDef.title: domain fortress guard
BackstoryDef.description: This Jaffa spent years on fortress duty, maintaining weapons, drilling patrols and reacting quickly whenever alarms sounded.

BackstoryDef.title: System Lord war veteran
BackstoryDef.description: This Jaffa survived campaigns between rival System Lords and learned that battlefield discipline mattered more than promises.

BackstoryDef.title: Jaffa drill instructor
BackstoryDef.description: Charged with preparing younger warriors, this Jaffa repeated old lessons until recruits could act without hesitation.

BackstoryDef.title: Goa'uld procession escort
BackstoryDef.description: This Jaffa escorted officials, priests and tribute caravans, remaining alert whenever displays of power invited resentment.

BackstoryDef.title: Jaffa garrison officer
BackstoryDef.description: Promoted within a domain garrison, this Jaffa coordinated sentries, supplies and discipline.

BackstoryDef.title: Chappa'ai sentinel
BackstoryDef.description: This Jaffa guarded a Chappa'ai and treated every activation as a possible arrival of allies, raiders or displeased superiors.

BackstoryDef.title: liberated Jaffa warrior
BackstoryDef.description: This Jaffa broke from Goa'uld service and learned to fight for a community rather than for the pride of a System Lord.

BackstoryDef.title: Free Jaffa community protector
BackstoryDef.description: This Jaffa defended an independent settlement where every patrol protected families, fields and the fragile idea of freedom.

BackstoryDef.title: Jaffa rebellion veteran
BackstoryDef.description: This Jaffa fought in an uprising against Goa'uld rule and carried forward lessons learned from victories and losses.

BackstoryDef.title: Free Jaffa scout
BackstoryDef.description: This Jaffa travelled between liberated communities, watching roads, ruins and Stargates for signs of returning enemies.

BackstoryDef.title: Free Jaffa artisan
BackstoryDef.description: This Jaffa built a civilian life after generations of imposed service, repairing tools and teaching practical crafts.

BackstoryDef.title: Free Jaffa farmer
BackstoryDef.description: This Jaffa worked the soil of an independent village and prepared carefully for the next season.

BackstoryDef.title: Free Jaffa healer
BackstoryDef.description: This Jaffa cared for neighbors with limited supplies, combining inherited knowledge with locally available remedies.

BackstoryDef.title: former Goa'uld deserter
BackstoryDef.description: This Jaffa deserted a Goa'uld force and spent years proving that leaving an old master was only the first step toward becoming free.

BackstoryDef.title: tributary-village child
BackstoryDef.description: Raised in a remote human settlement under distant rulers, this child learned that survival often depended on caution and cooperation.

BackstoryDef.title: palace-servant child
BackstoryDef.description: This child grew up among servants attached to a great household, learning to observe rank, mood and danger before speaking.

BackstoryDef.title: off-world market child
BackstoryDef.description: This child grew up around a busy off-world market where travelers, rumors and unfamiliar goods arrived from distant settlements.

BackstoryDef.title: temple ward
BackstoryDef.description: Raised near a temple complex, this child learned ceremonies, taboos and the uneasy silence expected around powerful visitors.

BackstoryDef.title: off-world caravan child
BackstoryDef.description: This child travelled with a caravan between scattered communities and learned to adapt quickly whenever the road changed.

BackstoryDef.title: remote-farm child
BackstoryDef.description: This child grew up on an isolated farm where weather, harvests and armed strangers shaped everyday life.

BackstoryDef.title: Goa'uld domain administrator
BackstoryDef.description: This Goa'uld managed tribute, labor and local disputes from the safety of a domain settlement.

BackstoryDef.title: Goa'uld palace emissary
BackstoryDef.description: This Goa'uld carried demands and promises between courts, treating every conversation as a test of influence.

BackstoryDef.title: Goa'uld tributary governor
BackstoryDef.description: This Goa'uld supervised a tributary community and learned to extract obedience without provoking rebellion.

BackstoryDef.title: Goa'uld cult priest
BackstoryDef.description: This Goa'uld cultivated ritual authority, encouraging worshippers to confuse fear, awe and loyalty.

BackstoryDef.title: Goa'uld archive keeper
BackstoryDef.description: This Goa'uld maintained records, artifacts and carefully edited histories intended to strengthen a domain.

BackstoryDef.title: Goa'uld court strategist
BackstoryDef.description: This Goa'uld advised a court where every alliance was temporary and every apparent concession concealed another calculation.

BackstoryDef.title: Goa'uld System Lord conqueror
BackstoryDef.description: This System Lord built a domain through conquest, tribute and carefully displayed cruelty.

BackstoryDef.title: Goa'uld System Lord dynast
BackstoryDef.description: This System Lord inherited an old domain and spent years preserving its image of permanence while rivals tested every border.

BackstoryDef.title: Goa'uld System Lord schemer
BackstoryDef.description: This System Lord preferred manipulation to open war, using emissaries, hostages and selective generosity to weaken rivals.

BackstoryDef.title: Goa'uld System Lord warlord
BackstoryDef.description: This System Lord ruled through military spectacle and expected Jaffa commanders to answer every setback with a harsher campaign.

BackstoryDef.title: Tok'ra infiltrator
BackstoryDef.description: This Tok'ra spent years behind hostile lines, cultivating patience and habits that made a false identity believable.

BackstoryDef.title: Tok'ra medic
BackstoryDef.description: This Tok'ra treated hosts, agents and allies with limited resources while weighing medical need against operational secrecy.

BackstoryDef.title: Tok'ra diplomat
BackstoryDef.description: This Tok'ra negotiated fragile cooperation with suspicious communities and learned that trust was earned gradually.

BackstoryDef.title: Tok'ra scout
BackstoryDef.description: This Tok'ra mapped safe routes, abandoned sites and enemy movements, often travelling with little more than a cover story.

BackstoryDef.title: Tok'ra intelligence analyst
BackstoryDef.description: This Tok'ra assembled scattered reports into useful intelligence and learned to distrust simple explanations.

BackstoryDef.title: Tok'ra courier
BackstoryDef.description: This Tok'ra carried messages and supplies between hidden cells, treating every journey as a test of discretion.
